card.title: Insider with the Wrong Memories
card.instruction: Act like an unquestioned insider while offering details that almost fit. Treat each contradiction as proof the group, system, or relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At our old reunions, Uncle Frank always carved the turkey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody here has an Uncle Frank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Families edit their history so quickly now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a remarkably efficient way to describe how much you've changed.

mechanism: A insists on family belonging while interpreting missing relatives and exclusion as changes in the family.
confusable: Unlike a simple mistaken reunion, A must preserve insider status by blaming the contradiction on others' change.
comparison: S220-b absorbs direct wrong-reunion correction; S220-a supplies club history despite a first meeting.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
